object.attr: as implemented: it isn't a conflict, and the object committed later is the less likely to be referred to already. Which date counts is to confirm in test mapping (review Q9). Replaced by MELLON-VER-SRS-332, MELLON-VER-SRS-333 and MELLON-VER-SRS-334 (Q-V5), which drop commit dates.
object.description: When both sides of a merge created different objects under one object ID, Mellon shall renumber, without asking the user, the object whose creating commit is the later one.
